_doc: Missions for the first boss and the first rival ace (round 3), in the missions.json shape, to fold into the campaign (ids match data/campaign.json's chain). Launch one directly for testing with ?mission=<id> (js/boss-ace-hooks.js). Comms lines can wait for boss/ace events: { event: 'boss' | 'bossPart' (part: id) | 'bossOpen' | 'bossPhase' (phase: 1|2) | 'bossDown' | 'aceIn' | 'aceDown', who, text }.

missions.name: Brood Queen
missions.brief: Something huge is laying eggs under the Crown. The swarm keeps coming back to it. Find it and put it down.

comms.text: You're over the Crown. Ground sensors are jumping — something heavy under the plaza. Stay mobile.
There she is. That's the mother of the lot. Those glowing sacs on her flanks are where the swarmers come from — burst them.
One sac down. The brood's thinning on that side.
Claw's off. She's dragging that side now.
Took her other claw. She'll have to spit at you instead.
Both sacs gone — her head plate's loose. Hit the glowing spot on her head.
She's angry. Watch for a red lane on the ground — that's her charging line. Get off it.
Seeing acid going up from her back. Circles on the ground, frame — don't stand in them.
She's down. Nothing's spawning. Take a breath, then grab what you can.
Pad's lit. Bring that chitin home — the workshop's going to want it.

missions.name: Sawtooth
missions.brief: Halden-Voss has sent one of its named pilots into Foundry Flats to hunt freelancers. Draw her out and beat her.

comms.text: Foundry Flats. Halden-Voss troopers on the ground — and they've brought someone special.
That's their ace. She fights like you do: boosts, dodges, runs hot. Make her burn her energy, then punish her.
She's out. Halden-Voss will remember that name — yours.
